exclusions.name: Mayoral veto or other procedural steps after council vote
exclusions.why_safe: The question asks only whether the council adopts the ordinance at the session. The charter's requirement is simply three affirmative votes (e3). No veto or subsequent step is mentioned in the evidence as part of adoption at the session.

exclusions.name: Other council members or alternates
exclusions.why_safe: The council has exactly five members (e1); no alternates or substitutes are mentioned in the evidence. Excluding others is safe because the charter and rules define the voting body as these five.

exclusions.name: Public comment or other agenda items
exclusions.why_safe: The question is specifically about the vote on Ordinance 2026-14. Other agenda items do not affect the vote outcome.

exclusions.name: Remote participation or proxy voting
exclusions.why_safe: Council rules require physical presence to vote and have no remote-participation provision (e4). Excluding remote voting is safe because it is not permitted.
